column1: # Shared matching fixture for the production-deploy pattern list
# scripts/tests/prod-deploy-guard.test.sh (the PreToolUse hook) and by the
# control plane's Go parity test, so both matchers must agree on every row.
# Format: command<TAB>expect, where expect is `ask` (some default pattern
# matches) or `none`. Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are ignored.
# The command column is decoded with three escapes, applied left to right with
# no overlap: `\\` -> `\`, `\n` -> newline, `\t` -> tab. Nothing else is special.
# Only the DEFAULT list applies here; project extras are tested by the suites.
# Each default pattern, hit at least once
# Breadth: `*` spans operators, quotes and lines, so these match on purpose
# A backslash in the command is literal text
# Literal `?` and `[` with nothing for a pattern to hit
# D1: bare --prod / --production are not in the list
# Near misses: right tool, wrong verb or target
# Anchoring and order: documented gaps, not wishes (a project extra closes them)
